newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA TOURISM CURRENCY INCOME UP 15.59 PCT H1.
newsitem.headline: CHINA TOURISM CURRENCY INCOME UP 15.59 PCT H1.

text.p: The Chinese tourist industry's foreign currency receipts reached $5.48 billion in the first half of 1997, climbing 15.59 percent from the same period last year, the People's Daily said on Friday.
China hosted 26.7 million tourists in the first six months, up 8.67 percent from the year-ago period, the newspaper said, quoting figures from the Tourism Bureau.

The number of non-Chinese tourists jumped 11.06 percent to 3.46 million, those from Hong Kong or Macao rose 7.32 percent to 22.1 million and those from Taiwan surged 37.32 percent to 1.07 million, it said.

The number of tourists from Asia and North America rose about 10 percent each. The number of Russian tourists soared about 20 percent, while Malaysian visitors increased the most, up 34.3 percent, the newspaper said without giving further details.
